Дренаж магии [Drain Magic]. Recharge 4–6. As an action, the caster releases the spell at a point or target within its listed range. The target resolves the saving throw or attack profile in this item data; on a failed save, it suffers the listed damage and conditions, while a successful save halves damage when the spell allows it. The spell cannot be used again until its recharge is rolled at the start of the caster’s turn.

The magic rises like a wound in the air, shaped by will and fear. Its power returns only when the winds gather again; until then it leaves the caster listening for the next tremor of sorcery beneath the world.

“The Old World rewards only those who turn fear into steel.”
— a scarred captain of the Empire

source.book: Warhammer: The Old World x D&D 5e
